query:
UPDATE dev_login_codes c SET consumed_at = COALESCE(c.consumed_at, NOW())
           FROM users u
           WHERE c.code_hash = $1
             AND (c.consumed_at IS NULL
                  OR c.consumed_at > NOW() - make_interval(secs => $2))
             AND c.expires_at > NOW()
             AND u.id = c.user_id
             AND u.status = 'active'
           RETURNING u.id AS "user_id: UserId",
                     u.email AS "email!",
                     COALESCE(u.display_name, u.name) AS "display_name!",
                     u.roles AS "roles!: Vec<String>"
